title: Glass-Box Deep Learning for FDIA Detection in Nonlinear Automatic Generation Control: A Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Approach
abstract: arXiv:2509.05259v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic Generation Control (AGC) plays a critical role in maintaining power balance across multi-area power systems. However, its complete reliance on remotely communicated measurements makes it susceptible to cyber-induced False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs), which can alter measurement values and destabilize system operation. Unlike prior studies that employ black-box Deep Learning (DL) models for FDIA detection, this paper proposes an interpretable and accurate Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based framework for detecting FDIAs in AGC systems, explicitly accounting for nonlinearities often overlooked in previous work. The proposed KAN model effectively identifies FDIAs in nonlinear AGC systems using only AGC measurements. Moreover, KANs inherently facilitate the extraction of symbolic equations, a capability absent in conventional DL models. translated_title: 面向非线性自动发电控制中虚假数据注入攻击检测的白盒深度学习：一种Kolmogorov-Arnold网络方法
translated_abstract: 自动发电控制（AGC）在维持多区域电力系统的功率平衡方面发挥着关键作用。然而，其完全依赖远程通信传输的测量数据，使其容易受到网络层面的虚假数据注入攻击（FDIA），此类攻击可篡改测量值并破坏系统运行的稳定性。与以往采用黑盒深度学习（DL）模型进行FDIA检测的研究不同，本文提出了一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的可解释且精确的框架，用于检测AGC系统中的FDIA，并显式考虑了以往工作中常被忽视的非线性特性。所提出的KAN模型仅利用AGC测量数据即可有效识别非线性AGC系统中的FDIA。此外，KAN天然支持符号方程的提取，这是传统深度学习模型所不具备的能力。训练完成后，这些符号方程可直接用于FDIA检测，从而提升检测性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的可解释深度学习框架，仅利用AGC测量数据即可有效检测非线性自动发电控制系统中常被忽视的虚假数据注入攻击，并能提取符号方程直接用于攻击检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based framework that effectively detects False Data Injection Attacks in nonlinear Automatic Generation Control systems using only AGC measurements, with the unique capability of extracting symbolic equations for direct FDIA detection.
